title: Prelude Workspace Schema
description: Schema for ~/.prelude/workspace.json: a user-level, machine-local registry of projects served by `prelude serve --workspace`. Not committed to any repository.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema for this file

version.description: Semantic version of the workspace format

name.description: Project name, from project.json or the directory name

path.description: Absolute path to the project root

alias.description: Short name used to address the project from agent tools
